records.source_intent: A record category outlives the body it was written for.
records.tin_structural_change: The record becomes an executable gate instead of a description: a filed category decides which route, door and combat roster are legal.
records.local_rule: A body may only be discussed after an arrival category has been filed for it, and the filed category becomes the only category the return registry accepts.

cross_link_a.how: The index NPC can only advance her own state after the filing window opens.

cross_link_b.how: Filing pushes the public record clock from circulating into filing.

records.immediate_consequence: Filing the arrival category opens the first route permission in the hub and consumes the declaration once.

delayed_consequence.what: When the public record clock reaches its filing stage the same category reclassifies the returning body in the kiln.

generic_risk_test.notes: The source surface is a bureaucratic sentence. Here the filing order is a gameplay gate, so renaming the record changes nothing about how the door behaves.
